verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies this. Entitlements decouple access from specific product identifiers, and Offerings and products are configured remotely, so new price points could be introduced as new products. Existing subscribers would plausibly keep access under the same entitlement. Nothing in the pack explicitly documents price-change handling, and the 'migrating existing subscriptions' docs cover importing purchases into RevenueCat, not moving cohorts to new prices. Missing for 10: documented plan/price versioning, explicit grandfathering of existing subscribers, bulk tools for migrating cohorts to new prices, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
